extended_validation_not_a_protocol_gate.description: Defensive cross-check (not required by the frozen protocol): scan_task's 81-field feature vectors compared against the live, already-compiled, already-tested tf_d170a_* FFI (via cgauto/rl_d170a_option_policy_env.py's D170aVecEnv, driven all-KEEP so budget is never spent and every armable state is visited), over map_seed 9,860,000-9,860,003 x 2 seats x 8 families = 64 tasks, 639 candidate rows.

bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_check.bug: decisions_seen_so_far (state field 62) computed once per simultaneous-candidate group instead of incremented per candidate within the group.
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_check.root_cause: D170a's own env calls observe_input() once per candidate, sequentially; decisions_seen is incremented inside decide() BETWEEN successive same-turn candidates (rl_d170a_option_policy_env.rs:1188), so candidate i (0-indexed within a simultaneous group) sees decisions_seen_so_far = baseline+i, not a shared snapshot.
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_check.fix: scan_task now recomputes state_family fresh for every candidate (incrementing decisions_seen between them), matching D170a's env exactly.
bugs_found_and_fixed_during_this_check.verification: Before the fix: 443/639 vectors mismatched, exactly the fixed-mark/return candidates in every multi-candidate group beyond the first, with diffs in exact multiples of 0.1 (=1/10, field 62's own divisor). After the fix: those 443 mismatches are gone (0 remaining on any fixed-mark or return candidate).

remaining_mismatches_after_fix.isolated_to: opt_fruit_trig / opt_iron_trig / opt_protect_trig candidates exclusively -- zero mismatches on any fixed-mark or opt_return candidate
remaining_mismatches_after_fix.explanation: NOT a bug: this is the deliberate, already-validated-correct divergence from D170a's own env recorded in the design-decision note above. D169a's own native trig-arm activation is pre-step, same-turn (`opp_worker_trigger_turn == current_turn`, d169a_resident_option_envelope.rs:903-904+925-926, independently confirmed by D169a's own test `trig_arm_configured_start_equals_observed_opponent_trigger_turn`). D170a's env offers the trig arms one turn later (turn+1) only because that file's own refresh_candidates/step_one_turn split cannot observe the trigger mid-turn -- an architecture-specific workaround for THAT file, not D169a's native semantics, and NOT what D172a's labels (sourced from d169a_play) require. Every one of the 63 remaining mismatches is a full 3-candidate group (all of fruit/iron/protect-trig together, at the group's own recorded turn) with no partial/field-isolated mismatches -- consistent with 'the whole group is offered one turn later in D170a's env, hence describes a different game state entirely', not a residual field-construction bug. The primary (D169a byte-exact) gate above is unaffected either way -- labels never touch state_family/decisions_seen at all.

extended_validation_not_a_protocol_gate.verdict: Consistent with the primary gate and the recorded design decision; no unexplained discrepancy remains.
